messages:
Marie (Sales): Quick heads-up: Acme needs a concise SIG follow-up focused on BCP/DR controls. They want RTO/RPO for Dedicated vs Hosted, backup cadence, failover steps, and test evidence. Deadline EOD Thu. @Jordan @Claire please.
Jordan (Eng-SRE): Got it. Are they considering Dedicated primarily? Numbers change a bit per deployment.
Marie (Sales): Yes Dedicated for production, but they asked for Hosted comparatives too. One page please.
Neil (Infra): Drafting numbers. Summary I can confirm: Dedicated: contractual availability 99.9%+, node-level automated failover <5m, full-region failover <60m (cross-region replicate). RPO: control-plane metadata <15m; customer data snapshots default daily, hourly optional add-on. Hosted (shared): multi-AZ with regional failover to nearest healthy region; observed failover 10-45m depending on warm capacity; no contractual RTO for self-serve. RPO: 24h default.
Claire (Security): Backups encrypted at rest; Private customers can bring KMS, Hosted/Dedicated use our managed KMS. Default retention 30d; extended retention available. We run quarterly restore drills on sample snapshots and annual Dedicated full DR exercises. Can provide last 3 test dates.
Jordan (Eng-SRE): Including a short runbook excerpt to paste into the one-pager: 
```
1) Detect outage via health checks/monitoring.
2) Promote warm secondary region, update routing & DNS TTLs.
3) Validate data consistency, warm caches, run smoke tests.
4) If errors >5% -> scale or trigger on-call.
5) Capture primary state and start post-mortem.
```
Claire (Security): Also note controls during failover: RBAC, audit trail with break-glass logging, signed change records. SOC2 scope covers these processes; we can reference relevant sections.
Alex (Sales-ops): I'll assemble the one-pager. Need links: DR test summary, snapshot policy, SLA. Anyone drop links and a redacted restore report?
Jordan (Eng-SRE): Links: SLA & uptime: https://redwood.example.com/legal/sla, Snapshot policy: https://redwood.example.com/docs/backups, DR test summary (redacted): https://redwood.example.com/internal/dr-tests/2025-q1-redacted
Claire (Security): I'll PM a redacted restore report PDF. Reminder: redact internal creds.
Marie (Sales): Thanks all — Alex and I will finish and send to Acme. If procurement demands formal attestation, tag legal. :pray:
